text.en: The Finance Act, 2026 amends several tax laws. Under the Income Tax Act, it adds a final tax on the rental income of non-residents from property in Kenya, adds scrap metal sales and winnings to the payments where tax is deducted at the source (1.5% of the gross amount for scrap metal, 20% for winnings), and sets the return deadline for individuals at the last day of the fourth month after the year of income. Under the VAT and Excise Duty Acts, it changes the lists of exempt goods and services and sets new excise rates, including 50% on antique, vintage and classic vehicles. Under the Tax Procedures Act, it requires virtual asset service providers to file information returns, lets the Commissioner determine tax liability where there is a tax avoidance scheme, and provides for pre-populated tax returns. Most sections start on 1st July, 2026, sections 17, 18 and 24 on 1st January, 2027, and section 43 on 1st September, 2026.
text.sw: Sheria ya Fedha ya 2026 inarekebisha sheria kadhaa za ushuru. Katika Sheria ya Ushuru wa Mapato, inaweka ushuru wa mwisho kwa mapato ya kodi ya pango ya wasio wakazi kutoka mali iliyoko Kenya, inaongeza uuzaji wa vyuma chakavu na zawadi za ushindi kwenye orodha ya malipo ambayo ushuru hukatwa chanzoni (asilimia 1.5 ya kiasi jumla kwa vyuma chakavu, asilimia 20 kwa zawadi za ushindi), na inaweka siku ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha marejesho ya watu binafsi kuwa siku ya mwisho ya mwezi wa nne baada ya mwaka wa mapato. Katika Sheria ya VAT na Sheria ya Ushuru wa Bidhaa, inabadilisha orodha za bidhaa na huduma zisizotozwa ushuru na kuweka viwango vipya vya ushuru wa bidhaa, ikiwemo asilimia 50 kwa magari ya kale, ya zamani na ya kikale. Katika Sheria ya Taratibu za Ushuru, inawataka watoaji huduma za mali pepe kuwasilisha marejesho ya taarifa, inamruhusu Kamishna kuamua deni la ushuru pale kuna mpango wa kukwepa ushuru, na inaweka marejesho ya ushuru yaliyojazwa awali. Vifungu vingi vinaanza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2026, vifungu vya 17, 18 na 24 tarehe 1 Januari 2027, na kifungu cha 43 tarehe 1 Septemba 2026.
text.sheng: Finance Act 2026 ina-amend sheria kadhaa za tax. Kwa Income Tax, ina-introduce final tax kwa non-residents wanaopata rental income from property in Kenya, ina-add scrap metal sales na winnings kwa list ya payments zenye tax deducted at source (1.5% ya gross kwa scrap metal, 20% kwa winnings), na ina-set deadline ya individual returns iwe end ya fourth month after the year of income. Kwa VAT na Excise Duty, ina-change lists za exempt goods na services na ina-set new excise rates, including 50% kwa antique, vintage na classic vehicles. Kwa Tax Procedures Act, virtual asset service providers wana-file information returns, Commissioner anaweza ku-determine tax liability kama kuna tax avoidance scheme, na kuna pre-populated returns. Sections nyingi zina-start 1st July 2026, sections 17, 18 na 24 zina-start 1st January 2027, na section 43 ina-start 1st September 2026.

text.en: A non-resident individual working for a national carrier air operator is not counted as earning income from Kenya for duties done outside Kenya that are part of the airline's international transport operation. A contribution to a gratuity (an end-of-contract payment) is added to a list in section 5(4) of the Income Tax Act, if the contract ran for at least three years and the gratuity is at most 31% of the pay earned over the contract period. The bill also rewrites section 12(1)(a), which covers a person who expects no taxable income for the year other than pay from employment.
text.sw: Mtu binafsi asiye mkazi anayefanya kazi na shirika la ndege la kitaifa hahesabiwi kuwa anapata mapato kutoka Kenya kwa kazi alizofanya nje ya Kenya ambazo ni sehemu ya shughuli za usafiri wa kimataifa za shirika hilo. Mchango wa malipo ya mwisho wa mkataba (gratuity) unaongezwa kwenye orodha katika kifungu cha 5(4) cha Sheria ya Ushuru wa Mapato, ikiwa mkataba ulidumu angalau miaka mitatu na malipo hayo hayazidi asilimia 31 ya mshahara uliopatikana katika kipindi cha mkataba. Mswada pia unaandika upya kifungu cha 12(1)(a), kinachomhusu mtu anayetarajia kutokuwa na mapato yanayotozwa ushuru kwa mwaka huo isipokuwa mshahara wa ajira.
text.sheng: Pay ya non-resident individual anayefanya kazi na national carrier haitakuwa counted kama income from Kenya, kama ni ya duties alizofanya outside Kenya na ni part ya international transport operation ya airline. Ina-add gratuity (end-of-contract payment) contributions kwa list ya section 5(4), kama contract ilikuwa at least three years na gratuity ni max 31% ya pay ya contract period. Pia ina-rewrite section 12(1)(a) kwa person ambaye hana taxable income nyingine other than pay ya employment.

text.en: Sales of scrap metal and winnings are added to the lists of payments where tax is deducted at source, at 1.5% of the gross amount for scrap metal and 20% for winnings. On VAT, scrap metal becomes exempt, spare parts are added to one exemption, and the wording on money transfer services and over-the-counter payment of household bills is rewritten, while payment processing, settlement and merchant services are left out of that exemption. The bill also removes a few other exemptions and adds exemptions for several other goods and services.
text.sw: Uuzaji wa vyuma chakavu na zawadi za ushindi vinaongezwa kwenye orodha za malipo ambayo ushuru hukatwa chanzoni, kwa asilimia 1.5 ya kiasi jumla kwa vyuma chakavu na asilimia 20 kwa zawadi za ushindi. Kwenye VAT, vyuma chakavu vinakuwa visivyotozwa ushuru, vipuri vinaongezwa kwenye msamaha mmoja, na maneno yanayohusu huduma za kutuma pesa na kulipa bili za nyumbani kwenye kaunta yanaandikwa upya, huku huduma za kuchakata malipo, kusuluhisha na za wafanyabiashara zikitolewa kwenye msamaha huo. Mswada pia unaondoa misamaha michache na kuongeza misamaha kwa bidhaa na huduma nyingine kadhaa.
text.sheng: Scrap metal sales na winnings zina-added kwa list ya payments zenye tax deducted at source, na rates ni 1.5% ya gross kwa scrap metal na 20% kwa winnings. Kwa VAT, scrap metal ina-become exempt, spare parts zina-added kwa one exemption, na ina-rewrite wording ya money transfer services na over-the-counter payment ya household bills, lakini payment processing, settlement na merchant services hazi-qualify. Pia ina-remove a few exemptions na ina-add exemptions za goods na services zingine.

text.en: The bill changes Part A of the VAT Second Schedule by deleting two paragraphs and tying the bicycle and batteries items to specific tariff headings (8712.00.00 and 8507.60.00). In the Excise Duty Act, it adds a 50% excise rate on antique, vintage and classic vehicles, and ties imported gas cylinders to a tariff code. It also reduces the amount in section 3(2) of the Road Maintenance Levy Fund Act from KSh 3 to KSh 1.50.
text.sw: Mswada unabadilisha Sehemu A ya Jedwali la Pili la VAT kwa kufuta vifungu viwili na kuunganisha vipengee vya baiskeli na betri na vichwa maalum vya ushuru wa forodha (8712.00.00 na 8507.60.00). Katika Sheria ya Ushuru wa Bidhaa, unaongeza kiwango cha ushuru wa bidhaa cha asilimia 50 kwa magari ya kale, ya zamani na ya kikale, na unaunganisha mitungi ya gesi inayoagizwa kutoka nje na msimbo maalum wa ushuru wa forodha. Pia unapunguza kiasi kilichoko katika kifungu cha 3(2) cha Sheria ya Mfuko wa Ushuru wa Matengenezo ya Barabara kutoka shilingi 3 hadi shilingi 1.50.
text.sheng: Kwa VAT Second Schedule Part A, ina-delete two paragraphs na ina-tie bicycle na batteries kwa specific tariff headings (8712.00.00 na 8507.60.00). Kwa Excise Duty, ina-add 50% excise rate kwa antique, vintage na classic vehicles, na ina-tie imported gas cylinders kwa tariff code. Pia ina-reduce amount ya Road Maintenance Levy Fund Act section 3(2) from KSh 3 to KSh 1.50.

clauses.heading: Short title and commencement.
clauses.text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Finance Act, 2026, and shall come into operation as follows- (a) on 1st January, 2027, section 17, 18, 24; (b)on 1st September, 2026, section 43; (c) all other sections, 1st July, 2026.

explanation.en: This section gives the law its name: the Finance Act, 2026. It also sets the dates when the sections start to apply. Sections 17, 18 and 24 start on 1st January 2027, section 43 starts on 1st September 2026, and all the other sections start on 1st July 2026.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaipa sheria jina lake: Finance Act, 2026 (Sheria ya Fedha, 2026). Pia kinaweka tarehe ambazo vifungu vinaanza kutumika. Vifungu vya 17, 18 na 24 vinaanza tarehe 1 Januari 2027, kifungu cha 43 kinaanza tarehe 1 Septemba 2026, na vifungu vingine vyote vinaanza tarehe 1 Julai 2026.
explanation.sheng: Section hii ina-give Act jina: Finance Act, 2026. Pia ina-set dates ambazo sections zina-start kufanya kazi. Sections 17, 18 na 24 zina-start 1st January 2027, section 43 ina-start 1st September 2026, na all the other sections zina-start 1st July 2026.

neutral_check.note: Short title and commencement dates only, described as written with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 2 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 2. Section 2 of the Income Tax Act is amended in subsection ( 1) - ( a) in the definition of "immovable property", by deleting the word "and" appearing immediately after the words " immovable property" the end of at item (a), and substituting therefor the word "or"'; (b) in the definition of "management or professional fee", by inserting the words "and includes interchange fees and merchant service fees arising from transactions that use a card as a means of payment" immediately after the word "calculated"; (c) by deleting the definition of "royalty" and substituting therefor the following new definition- "royalty" means a payment made as a consideration for the use or the right to use- (a) any copyright of a literary, artistic or scientific work; (b) any software, proprietary or off-the-shelf, whether in the form of licence, development, training, maintenance or support fees; ( c) any cinematograph film including a film or tape for radio or television broadcasting; (d)any patent, trademark, design or model, plan, formula or process; (e) any industrial, commercial or scientific equipment; (f) information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific equipment or experience, and any gains derived from the sale or exchange of any right or property giving rise to that royalty; or (g) a proprietary digital payment card network or platform, including access, participation or usage rights in such system through a card, whether the consideration is periodic or transaction-based and whether or not the payment is described as a service fee, transaction fee, network fee, assessment fee, processing fee or similar charge. (d) by deleting the definition of "withdrawals" and substituting therefor the following new definition- "withdrawals" means any amount of money, cash equivalent, or money's worth paid or disbursed to the account of a player, by a person licensed under the Gambling Control Act, 2025; (e) by inserting the following new definition in proper alphabetical sequence- "winnings" means a pay-out from a lottery or prize competition by a person licensed under the Gambling Control Act, 2025.

explanation.en: Section 2 of the Income Tax Act changes five definitions. In "immovable property", the word "and" after item (a) becomes "or", and "management or professional fee" now also includes interchange fees and merchant service fees from card payments. "Royalty" gets a new definition covering payments for using copyright, software, films, patents, trademarks, designs, equipment and related information, gains from selling those rights, and use of a proprietary digital payment card network or platform, whatever the charge is called. "Withdrawals" now means money or its equivalent paid to a player's account by a person licensed under the Gambling Control Act, 2025, and "winnings" is newly defined as a pay-out from a lottery or prize competition by such a licensed person.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 2 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kinabadilisha fasili tano. Katika "immovable property", neno "and" baada ya kipengele (a) linakuwa "or", na "management or professional fee" sasa inajumuisha pia ada za interchange na ada za huduma za wafanyabiashara zinazotokana na malipo ya kadi. "Royalty" inapata fasili mpya inayohusu malipo ya kutumia hakimiliki, programu za kompyuta, filamu, hataza, chapa za biashara, michoro, vifaa na taarifa zinazohusiana, faida za kuuza haki hizo, na matumizi ya mtandao au jukwaa la kadi za malipo la kidijitali lenye umiliki, bila kujali malipo hayo yanaitwaje. "Withdrawals" sasa inamaanisha pesa au kitu kinacholingana na pesa kilicholipwa kwenye akaunti ya mchezaji na mtu mwenye leseni chini ya Sheria ya Udhibiti wa Michezo ya Kubahatisha ya mwaka 2025, na "winnings" inafafanuliwa upya kama malipo ya ushindi kutoka bahati nasibu au mashindano ya zawadi yanayotolewa na mwenye leseni.
explanation.sheng: Section 2 ya Income Tax Act ina-change definitions tano. Kwa "immovable property", word "and" after item (a) inakuwa "or", na "management or professional fee" sasa ina-include interchange fees na merchant service fees from card payments. "Royalty" ina new definition: payment for use ya copyright, software, films, patents, trademarks, designs, equipment na related information, gains from selling hizo rights, na pia use ya proprietary digital payment card network au platform, hata fee ikiitwa name yoyote. "Withdrawals" sasa ni pesa paid to account ya player na person licensed under Gambling Control Act, 2025, na "winnings" ni pay-out from lottery au prize competition na licensed person huyo.

neutral_check.note: Definitions clause described factually, with no opinion, advice or judgment on legality.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 5 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 3. Section 5 of the Income Tax Act is amended - (a) in subsection (1) by inserting the following proviso - Provided that the income of a non-resident individual employed by, or engaged on behalf of, a resident air transport operator designated by the Government as a national carrier shall not be deemed to accrue in or be derived from Kenya to the extent that the income is related to duties of the individual performed outside Kenya and the international transport operation of the air transport operator. (b) in subsection (4) by inserting the following new paragraph immediately after paragraph (g) - (ga) any contribution to a gratuity in respect of employment or services rendered: Provided that- (i) the gratuity was for a contract of service for the continuous period of at least three years or, renewal or extension of such contract beyond three years; and (ii) the amount paid as gratuity does not exceed thirty-one per cent of the emoluments, earned by the employee for the period of the contract.

explanation.en: This section changes section 5 of the Income Tax Act in two ways. First, it adds a condition: the income of a non-resident individual who works for, or is engaged on behalf of, a Kenyan air transport operator designated by the Government as a national carrier is not treated as earned in or coming from Kenya, to the extent it relates to duties done outside Kenya and the carrier's international transport operation. Second, it adds a new item to the list in subsection (4): contributions to a gratuity (an end-of-contract payment), where the contract ran for at least three continuous years, or was renewed or extended beyond three years, and the gratuity is not more than 31% of what the employee earned over the contract period.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha kifungu cha 5 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, kinaongeza sharti kwamba mapato ya mtu asiye mkazi anayeajiriwa na kampuni ya usafiri wa anga ya hapa nchini iliyoteuliwa na Serikali kuwa shirika la taifa, au anayehudumu kwa niaba yake, hayachukuliwi kuwa yamepatikana Kenya au kutoka Kenya, kadiri yanavyohusiana na kazi alizofanya nje ya Kenya na shughuli za kimataifa za usafiri za shirika hilo. Pili, kinaongeza kipengele kipya katika orodha ya kifungu kidogo cha (4): michango ya kiinua mgongo (gratuity), yaani malipo ya mwisho wa mkataba, ikiwa mkataba ulikuwa wa angalau miaka mitatu mfululizo, au uliongezwa muda zaidi ya miaka mitatu, na kiinua mgongo hicho hakizidi asilimia 31 ya mapato aliyopata mfanyakazi katika kipindi cha mkataba.
explanation.sheng: Section hii inarekebisha section 5 ya Income Tax Act kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, income ya non-resident anayefanya kazi na national carrier (airline ambayo Government imeteua) haitakuwa counted kama income from Kenya, kama ni ya work aliyofanya outside Kenya na international flights za airline hiyo. Pili, ina-add contributions za gratuity (end-of-contract payment) kwa list ya subsection (4), kama contract ilikuwa at least three years continuous au ime-extend beyond three years, na gratuity haizidi 31% ya pay ya employee kwa contract period.

neutral_check.note: Described only what the two amendments do and their stated conditions, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Insertion ofa new section 6B to Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 4. The Income Tax Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 6A- Impositionofnon- 6B. (1) Where the income of a non- . resident rental income res1'd e nt person 1s accru ed m. or d en. ve d fro m tax. the use or occupation of property situated in Kenya, a tax to be known as non-resident rental income tax shall be payable by that non-resident person at the rate specified in the Third Schedule which shall be a final tax on the income. (2)A non-resident person subject to the tax payable under subsection (1) shall- (a) register and account for the tax through a simplified registration framework prescribed by the Commissioner; and (b) submit a return and pay the tax due on or before the twentieth day of the month following the end of the month for which the rent is paid. (3) Subsection (2) shall not apply where the income accrued in or derived from the use or occupation of the property is received by a resident person on behalf of the non-resident person who is subject to the deduction of tax specified in section 35 (1) (c).

explanation.en: This section adds a new section 6B to the Income Tax Act. A non-resident person (someone not resident in Kenya for tax purposes) whose income comes from using or occupying property in Kenya pays a tax called non-resident rental income tax, at the rate in the Third Schedule. It is a final tax, so no further income tax is charged on that income. That person must register through a simplified system set by the Commissioner, and file a return and pay by the 20th day of the month after the month the rent is paid. These steps do not apply where a resident person receives the rent on behalf of the non-resident and tax is deducted under section 35(1)(c).
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaongeza kifungu kipya cha 6B kwenye Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Mtu asiye mkazi wa Kenya kwa madhumuni ya kodi, ambaye mapato yake yanatokana na matumizi au ukaaji wa mali iliyoko Kenya, hulipa kodi inayoitwa kodi ya mapato ya kodi ya pango ya wasio wakazi, kwa kiwango kilichoainishwa katika Jedwali la Tatu. Hii ni kodi ya mwisho, kwa hiyo hakuna kodi nyingine ya mapato inayotozwa kwa mapato hayo. Mtu huyo husajiliwa kupitia mfumo rahisi wa usajili ulioamuliwa na Kamishna, na huwasilisha marejesho na kulipa kodi kabla ya siku ya ishirini ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi ambao pango lililipwa. Hatua hizi hazitumiki pale mtu mkazi anapopokea pango kwa niaba ya asiye mkazi na kodi ikakatwa chini ya kifungu cha 35(1)(c).
explanation.sheng: Section 4 ina-add section mpya 6B kwa Income Tax Act. Non-resident (mtu ambaye si resident wa Kenya kwa tax) anayepata income from property iliyo Kenya ana-pay non-resident rental income tax kwa rate iliyo kwa Third Schedule. Hii ni final tax, so hakuna income tax nyingine kwa hiyo rent income. Huyo non-resident ana-register kupitia simplified registration system ya Commissioner, na ana-submit return na ku-pay tax by 20th ya month after the month rent ilipolipwa. Kama resident person ana-receive rent on behalf ya non-resident na tax ina-deductiwa under section 35(1)(c), hizo steps za register na return haziu-apply.

neutral_check.note: Describes only who pays, the final tax, the registration and payment deadline, and the exception, with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 8 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 5. Section 8 of the Income Tax Act is amended by deleting subsection (SA).

explanation.en: This section removes subsection (SA) from section 8 of the Income Tax Act. It is a deletion only: nothing is added in its place. The clause does not say what subsection (SA) contained, so that content is found in the Income Tax Act itself.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinafuta kifungu kidogo cha (SA) kutoka kifungu cha 8 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Ni ufutaji tu: hakuna kinachoongezwa badala yake. Kifungu hiki hakieleza kifungu kidogo cha (SA) kilikuwa na nini, kwa hivyo maudhui yake yako katika Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato yenyewe.
explanation.sheng: Section 5 ina-delete subsection (SA) kutoka section 8 ya Income Tax Act. Ni small amendment: ina-delete tu, na hakuna new text inayowekwa badala yake. Clause hii haisemi subsection (SA) ilikuwa na nini, so text yake iko kwa Income Tax Act yenyewe.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the deletion of subsection (SA); the clause does not state its content, so no effect or judgement is described.

clauses.heading: Amendment to section 9 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 6. Section 9 of the Income Tax Act is amended by inserting the following new subsection immediately after subsection (1)- (lA) The tax charged on the income under subsection (1) shall be payable within five days after the payment is received or the ship leaves the port of lading, whichever is earlier.

explanation.en: This section adds a new subsection (1A) to section 9 of the Income Tax Act. It sets a deadline for paying the tax charged on the income covered by subsection (1): within five days after the payment is received, or after the ship leaves the port where its cargo was loaded (the port of lading), whichever comes first.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaongeza kifungu kidogo kipya cha (1A) katika kifungu cha 9 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Kinaweka muda wa kulipa kodi inayotozwa kwa mapato yaliyo chini ya kifungu kidogo cha (1): ndani ya siku tano baada ya malipo kupokelewa, au baada ya meli kuondoka bandarini ambako mizigo ilipakiwa, yoyote itakayotangulia.
explanation.sheng: Section 6 ina-add new subsection (1A) kwa section 9 ya Income Tax Act. Inasema tax kwa income ya subsection (1) ni payable within five days after payment ku-receiviwa, au after ship ku-leave port where cargo ilipakiwa (port of lading), whichever comes first.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the new payment deadline in subsection (1A), with no opinion on the policy.

clauses.heading: Amendment to section lO of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 7. Section 10 of the Income Tax Act is amended in subsection (1), by inserting the following new paragraphs immediately after paragraph (m)- (n)sale of scrap metal; (o)winnings.

explanation.en: This section changes section 10(1) of the Income Tax Act by adding two new items to the list, straight after item (m): (n) sale of scrap metal and (o) winnings. These two items now sit in the list of payments that section 10 covers, where tax is deducted at source, meaning before the money reaches the person receiving it. This section does not itself give any tax rates.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha kifungu cha 10(1) cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kwa kuongeza vipengele viwili vipya mara baada ya kipengele (m): (n) uuzaji wa vyuma chakavu na (o) zawadi za ushindi. Vipengele hivi vinaingia kwenye orodha ya malipo yanayohusika na kifungu cha 10, ambapo kodi hukatwa chanzoni, yaani kabla pesa hazijamfikia mpokeaji. Kifungu hiki chenyewe hakitaji viwango vyovyote vya kodi.
explanation.sheng: Section hii ina-amend section 10(1) ya Income Tax Act kwa ku-add two new items kwa list, right after (m): (n) sale ya scrap metal na (o) winnings. Items hizi mbili sasa ziko kwa list ya payments ambazo section 10 inacover, ambapo tax ina-deducted at source, yaani kabla pesa i-reach the person receiving it. Section hii yenyewe haina rates za tax.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the two items added to the list in section 10(1); no rates, opinion, advice or legal verdict stated.

clauses.heading: Repeal and replacement of section 11 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 8. The Income Tax Act is amended by repealing section 11 and replacing it with the following new section- Trust income deemed 11. (1) Any income chargeable to tax income of trustee. and received by a person in the capacity of a trustee, executor or administrator, shall be deemed to be the income of that trustee, executor or administrator. (2) Qualifying dividend or qualifying interest which is included in the income of the trustee, executor or administrator under subsection (1) shall not be subject to further tax under this Act. (3) Where a trustee, executor or administrator has paid tax on the chargeable income of the trust, a beneficiary of the trust shall not be liable to pay tax on that income.

explanation.en: This section removes the current section 11 of the Income Tax Act and puts a new one in its place, about income received by a trustee, executor or administrator (a person who manages property for others, or an estate for someone who has died). Income that is chargeable to tax and received in that role is treated as that person's own income. Qualifying dividend or qualifying interest counted in that income is not taxed again under the Act. If the trustee, executor or administrator has already paid tax on the chargeable income of the trust, a beneficiary does not pay tax on that same income.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinafuta kifungu cha 11 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato na kukibadilisha na kipya kuhusu mapato yanayopokelewa na mdhamini, msimamizi wa wasia au msimamizi wa mali ya marehemu. Mapato yanayotozwa kodi na kupokelewa kwa nafasi hiyo huchukuliwa kuwa mapato ya mdhamini au msimamizi huyo. Gawio au riba inayostahili iliyojumuishwa katika mapato hayo haitozwi kodi tena chini ya Sheria hii. Ikiwa mdhamini au msimamizi amelipa kodi kwa mapato yanayotozwa kodi ya amana hiyo, mnufaika wa amana hatalazimika kulipa kodi kwa mapato hayo.
explanation.sheng: Section 8 ina-repeal section 11 ya Income Tax Act na ku-replace na new section about income inayopokelewa na trustee, executor au administrator (person anayesimamia property ya wengine au estate ya mtu aliyekufa). Income yoyote inayotozwa tax ikipokelewa kwa role hiyo ina-count kama income ya trustee, executor au administrator mwenyewe. Qualifying dividend na qualifying interest zilizo kwa income hiyo haziwi taxed tena chini ya Act. Kama trustee, executor au administrator ameshalipa tax kwa income ya trust, beneficiary hatalipa tax kwa income hiyo.

neutral_check.note: Describes only what the replacement section 11 does for trustees, executors, administrators and beneficiaries, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 12 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 9. Section 12 of the Income Tax Act is amended in subsection (1), by deleting paragraph (a) and substituting therefor the following new paragraph- (a) if, to the best of his judgement and belief, he will have no income chargeable to tax for that year of income other than emoluments.

explanation.en: This section changes section 12(1) of the Income Tax Act. It removes paragraph (a) and puts a new paragraph (a) in its place. The new paragraph sets this condition: a person believes, to the best of their judgement, that for that year of income they will have no taxable income other than emoluments (pay from employment, such as salary and wages).
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha kifungu cha 12(1) cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Kinafuta aya (a) na kuweka aya mpya (a) mahali pake. Aya mpya inaweka sharti kwamba mtu anaamini, kwa kadiri ya uamuzi wake bora, kwamba kwa mwaka huo wa mapato hatakuwa na mapato yanayotozwa kodi isipokuwa malipo ya ajira (kama mshahara na ujira).
explanation.sheng: Section 9 ina-amend section 12 ya Income Tax Act. Ina-delete paragraph (a) ya subsection (1) na ku-replace na new paragraph (a). Hii new paragraph inaweka condition hii: mtu ana-believe, kwa best ya judgement yake, kwamba kwa that year of income hatakuwa na taxable income other than pay ya employment (kama salary na wages).

neutral_check.note: Describes only the replaced paragraph and its condition as written, with no judgement on its effect.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 15 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 10.Section 15 of the Income Tax Act is amended- (a) in subsection (2) by inserting the following new proviso in paragraph (a) - Provided that in the case of a person carrying on a money lending business, a bank or financial institution licensed under the Banking Act, the Microfinance Act and the Central Bank of Kenya Act, a debt that has become bad in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Commissioner shall include the principal, interest and any other amount relating to the debt; (b) in subsection (4) by inserting the following new proviso- Provided that any person who before the 1st July, 2025 had invested at least ten billion shillings in Kenya and who, after the ascertainment of income had resulted in a deficit, and the deficit had been ascertained in respect of any period before the 1st July, 2025, the deficit shall be deemed to have occurred in the 2025 year of income of that person and the deduction may be applied by that person beyond the period specified in subsection (4)until it is extinguished.

explanation.en: Section 10 makes two changes to section 15 of the Income Tax Act. First, for a money lending business and for a bank or financial institution licensed under the Banking Act, the Microfinance Act and the Central Bank of Kenya Act, a debt that has become bad under the Commissioner's guidelines includes the principal, the interest and any other amount linked to the debt. Second, a person who had invested at least ten billion shillings in Kenya before 1 July 2025, and who had a deficit (income that came out below expenses) ascertained for a period before that date, has that deficit treated as arising in their 2025 year of income. The deduction for it can then be used beyond the period set in subsection (4) until it is used up.
explanation.sw: Sehemu ya 10 inafanya mabadiliko mawili kwa kifungu cha 15 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Kwanza, kwa biashara ya kukopesha pesa na kwa benki au taasisi ya fedha yenye leseni chini ya Sheria ya Benki, Sheria ya Taasisi za Fedha Ndogo na Sheria ya Benki Kuu ya Kenya, deni lililogeuka kuwa deni mbaya kulingana na miongozo ya Kamishna linajumuisha mtaji, riba na kiasi kingine chochote kinachohusiana na deni hilo. Pili, mtu aliyewekeza angalau shilingi bilioni kumi nchini Kenya kabla ya tarehe 1 Julai 2025, na ambaye alikuwa na nakisi (mapato yaliyokuwa chini ya matumizi) iliyothibitishwa kwa kipindi cha kabla ya tarehe hiyo, nakisi hiyo inachukuliwa kuwa ilitokea katika mwaka wake wa mapato wa 2025. Makato yake yanaweza kutumika zaidi ya kipindi kilichowekwa katika kifungu kidogo cha (4) hadi yamalizike kabisa.
explanation.sheng: Section 10 ina-change section 15 ya Income Tax Act kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, kwa money lending business na kwa bank au financial institution yenye licence chini ya Banking Act, Microfinance Act na Central Bank of Kenya Act, bad debt kulingana na guidelines za Commissioner ina-include principal, interest na amount nyingine yoyote ya debt hiyo. Pili, mtu aliyekuwa ame-invest at least ten billion shillings Kenya before 1st July 2025, na alikuwa na deficit (income ilikuwa chini ya expenses) for period before that date, deficit hiyo ina-count kama ilitokea kwa 2025 year of income yake. Deduction yake inaweza kutumika hata after period ya subsection (4) mpaka deficit imeisha kabisa.

neutral_check.note: Describes the two provisos only, with no opinion on policy, legality or advice.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section I 6 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 11.Section 16 of the Income Tax Act is amended in subsection (2) (j) (iii) (E) by deleting the words "lending and leasing business" appearing after the words "involved in" and substituting therefor the words "lending or leasing business, or both".

explanation.en: This section makes a small wording change to section 16 of the Income Tax Act, in subsection (2)(j)(iii)(E). It deletes the words "lending and leasing business" after "involved in" and puts in "lending or leasing business, or both". The wording now names lending, leasing, or both, instead of joining the two with "and" alone. It adds no new rate, amount or date.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinafanya badiliko dogo la maneno katika kifungu cha 16 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, kifungu kidogo cha (2)(j)(iii)(E). Kinafuta maneno "lending and leasing business" yanayokuja baada ya "involved in" na kuweka "lending or leasing business, or both", yaani biashara ya kukopesha, ya kukodisha, au zote mbili. Hakuna kiwango, kiasi wala tarehe mpya inayowekwa.
explanation.sheng: Section 11 ina-amend section 16 ya Income Tax Act, kwa subsection (2)(j)(iii)(E). Ina-delete words "lending and leasing business" baada ya "involved in" na ku-replace na "lending or leasing business, or both". Ni small change ya wording: sasa inataja lending, leasing, au both. Haina rate, amount wala date mpya.

neutral_check.note: Technical wording amendment described literally, with no opinion on its effect or merit.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 18D of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 12.Section 18D of the Income Tax Act is amended- (a) in subsection (1), by deleting the expression "subsection (3)" appearing after the words "accordance with" and substituting therefor the expression "subsection (2)"; (b) in subsection (2), by deleting the expression "subsection (1)" appearing after the words "accordance with" and substituting therefor the expression "subsections (1) and (lA)''; (c) in subsection (5), by deleting the expression "subsection (1 )" appearing after the words "accordance with" and substituting therefor the expression "subsections (1) and (lA)".

explanation.en: Section 12 makes three small technical corrections to section 18D of the Income Tax Act. Each one only changes a reference to another subsection. In subsection (1), the reference to subsection (3) becomes a reference to subsection (2). In subsections (2) and (5), the reference to subsection (1) becomes a reference to subsections (1) and (1A).
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 12 kinafanya marekebisho matatu madogo ya kiufundi katika kifungu cha 18D cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Kila marekebisho yanabadilisha tu rejeleo la kifungu kidogo kingine. Katika kifungu kidogo cha (1), rejeleo la kifungu kidogo cha (3) linakuwa rejeleo la kifungu kidogo cha (2). Katika vifungu vidogo vya (2) na (5), rejeleo la kifungu kidogo cha (1) linakuwa rejeleo la vifungu vidogo vya (1) na (1A).
explanation.sheng: Section 12 ina-make three small technical changes kwa section 18D ya Income Tax Act. Kila change ina-update tu reference kwenda subsection nyingine. Kwa subsection (1), reference ya subsection (3) inakuwa reference ya subsection (2). Kwa subsections (2) na (5), reference ya subsection (1) inakuwa reference ya subsections (1) na (1A).

neutral_check.note: Purely technical cross-reference changes, described as they are with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section I 8F of Cap.470.
clauses.text: 13.Section 18F of the Income Tax Act is amended- ( a) in the definition of "a country-by-country report", by deleting the expression "section 18D (1)" appearing after the words "filed under" and substituting therefor the expression "section 18D (1)and (lA)"; (b) in the definition of "excluded multinational enterprise group", by deleting the expression "section 18D (1)" appearing after the words "specified in" and substituting therefor the expression "section 18D (lB)"; ( c) by deleting the definition of "ultimate parent entity" and substituting therefor the following new definition- "ultimate parent entity" means a constituent entity of a multinational enterprise group where- ( a) the constituent entity owns directly or indirectly a sufficient interest in one or more other constituent entities of the multinational enterprise group; (b) the constituent entity is required to prepare consolidated financial statements under accounting principles generally applied in its jurisdiction of tax residence, or would be so required if its equity interests were traded on a public securities exchange in its jurisdiction of tax residence; and ( c) there is no other constituent entity of the multinational enterprise group that owns, directly or indirectly, a sufficient interest in any of the other constituent entities of the multinational enterprise group.

explanation.en: Section 18F of the Income Tax Act holds definitions used for country-by-country reports of multinational groups, and this section changes three of them. Two are updates to cross-references: the definition of a country-by-country report now points to section 18D (1) and (1A), and the definition of an excluded multinational enterprise group now points to section 18D (1B). The third replaces the definition of "ultimate parent entity". It is a member of a multinational group that owns a sufficient stake, directly or indirectly, in other members, that must prepare consolidated financial statements in the country where it is tax resident (or would have to if its shares were publicly traded there), and that has no other member of the group above it owning a sufficient stake in the group's other members.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 18F cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kina fasili zinazotumika kwa ripoti za nchi-kwa-nchi za makundi ya kimataifa ya kampuni, na kifungu hiki kinabadilisha fasili tatu. Mbili ni masahihisho ya marejeleo: fasili ya ripoti ya nchi-kwa-nchi sasa inarejelea kifungu cha 18D (1) na (1A), na fasili ya kundi la kimataifa la kampuni lililoondolewa inarejelea kifungu cha 18D (1B). Ya tatu inaondoa fasili ya "taasisi mama ya mwisho" na kuweka mpya: ni mwanachama wa kundi la kimataifa anayemiliki hisa za kutosha, moja kwa moja au kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja, katika wanachama wengine, anayetakiwa kuandaa taarifa za fedha zilizounganishwa katika nchi anakoishi kikodi (au angetakiwa ikiwa hisa zake zingeuzwa hadharani huko), na ambaye hakuna mwanachama mwingine wa kundi aliye juu yake anayemiliki hisa za kutosha katika wanachama wengine wa kundi.
explanation.sheng: Section 18F ya Income Tax Act ina definitions za country-by-country report za multinational groups, na section hii ina-change definitions tatu. Definition ya country-by-country report sasa ina-refer section 18D (1) na (1A), na ile ya excluded multinational enterprise group ina-refer section 18D (1B). Pia ina-replace definition ya ultimate parent entity: ni member wa group anayeya-own stake ya kutosha kwa members wengine, anatakiwa ku-prepare consolidated financial statements kwa country anayolipia tax (au angetakiwa kama shares zake zingekuwa listed kwa stock exchange huko), na hakuna member mwingine wa group juu yake anayeya-own stake ya kutosha kwa members wengine wa group.

neutral_check.note: Definitions and cross-reference amendment only; described what changes without opinion, advice or legal judgment.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 19 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 14.Section 19 of the Income Tax Act is amended­ (a) in subsection (5)- (i) by deleting the words "life insurance fund" appearing in paragraph (a) and substituting therefor the words "statutory fund"; and (ii) by deleting the words "life insurance fund" appearing in paragraph (b) and substituting therefor the words "statutory fund"; (b) in subsection (5A), by deleting the words "life insurance fund" wherever they occur and substituting therefor the words "statutory fund"; ( c) in subsection ( 6), by deleting the words "life insurance fund" appearing in paragraph (b) and substituting therefor the words "statutory fund"; (d) in subsection (6A), by deleting the words "life insurance fund" wherever they occur and substituting therefor the words "statutory fund"; ( e) in subsection 7 - (i) in the definition of "annuity fund", by deleting the words "life insurance fund" wherever they occur and substituting therefor the words "statutory fund"; (ii) by deleting the definition of "life insurance fund"; (iii) by inserting the following new definition in proper alphabetical sequence- "statutory fund" means a fund established under section 45 of the Insurance Act.

explanation.en: This section is a technical amendment to section 19 of the Income Tax Act. In subsections (5), (5A), (6), (6A) and (7) (including the definition of "annuity fund"), the words "life insurance fund" are replaced with "statutory fund". The old definition of "life insurance fund" is deleted, and a new definition is added: a "statutory fund" means a fund established under section 45 of the Insurance Act.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki ni marekebisho madogo ya kiufundi kwa kifungu cha 19 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Katika vifungu vidogo vya (5), (5A), (6), (6A) na (7) (pamoja na ufafanuzi wa "annuity fund"), maneno "life insurance fund" yanabadilishwa na "statutory fund". Ufafanuzi wa "life insurance fund" unafutwa, na ufafanuzi mpya unaongezwa: "statutory fund" ni hazina iliyoanzishwa chini ya kifungu cha 45 cha Sheria ya Bima.
explanation.sheng: Section 14 ni technical amendment ya section 19 ya Income Tax Act, na ni change ya name tu. Kila time subsections (5), (5A), (6), (6A) na (7) (pamoja na definition ya "annuity fund") zinasema "life insurance fund", sasa zitasema "statutory fund". Definition ya "life insurance fund" inadeletiwa, na definition mpya ina-add: "statutory fund" ni fund established under section 45 ya Insurance Act.

neutral_check.note: Purely a wording and definition change, described as it stands with no opinion, advice or legal judgment.

clauses.heading: Repeal of section 23 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 15.The Income Tax Act is amended by repealing section 23.

explanation.en: This section removes section 23 from the Income Tax Act (Cap. 470). To repeal means the section is deleted and is no longer part of the Act. The clause itself does not say what section 23 covered.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinafuta kifungu cha 23 cha Sheria ya Ushuru wa Mapato (Cap. 470). Kufuta kunamaanisha kwamba kifungu hicho kinaondolewa na hakiendelei kuwa sehemu ya sheria hiyo. Maandishi ya kifungu hiki hayaelezi kifungu cha 23 kilihusu nini.
explanation.sheng: Section hii ina-repeal section 23 ya Income Tax Act (Cap. 470). Ku-repeal ni ku-remove section hiyo kutoka Act, so haitakuwa part ya Act tena. Clause hii haisemi section 23 ilikuwa inahusu nini.

neutral_check.note: Only states that section 23 is repealed; the clause does not describe its content, so no effect is described or judged.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 35 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 16.Section 35 of the Income Tax Act is amended- (a) in subsection (1)- (i) by deleting the word "travel" appearing in paragraph (a) (ii) and substituting therefor the words "transport services"; (ii) by deleting paragraph (u); (iii) by adding the following new paragraphs immediately after paragraph (u)- (v)the sale of scrap metal; (w)winnings; (b) by inserting the following new subsection immediately after subsection (1)- (lA) Subsection (1) shall not apply to payments made by a resident air transport operator designated by the Government as a national carrier to a non-resident person in respect of access to, participation in or use of a proprietary digital platform, payment network, payment-card scheme, payment processing system, switching system, clearing system or settlement system, including access, participation or usage rights in the system through a card, whether the consideration is periodic or transaction-based and whether or not the payment is described as a service fee, transaction fee, network fee, assessment fee, processing fee or similar charge. (c) in subsection (3) by adding the following new paragraph immediately after paragraph (o)- (p)the sale of scrap metal; (q)winnings.

explanation.en: This section changes the list of payments in section 35 of the Income Tax Act that have tax deducted at source. In subsection (1), the word "travel" becomes "transport services" in one paragraph, paragraph (u) is deleted, and sale of scrap metal and winnings are added as new paragraphs (v) and (w). A new subsection (1A) says subsection (1) does not apply to payments by a resident airline that the Government has designated as the national carrier, when paid to a non-resident for access to or use of a digital or payment system (such as a card scheme or payment network), whatever the fee is called. In subsection (3), sale of scrap metal and winnings are also added to the list, as paragraphs (p) and (q).
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinabadilisha orodha ya malipo yanayokatwa kodi chini ya kifungu cha 35 cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato (Income Tax Act), ambapo kodi hukatwa wakati wa malipo. Katika kifungu kidogo cha (1), neno "travel" linabadilishwa kuwa "transport services" katika aya moja, aya (u) inafutwa, na uuzaji wa vyuma chakavu na ushindi (winnings) vinaongezwa kama aya mpya (v) na (w). Kifungu kidogo kipya cha (1A) kinasema kifungu kidogo cha (1) hakitumiki kwa malipo yanayofanywa na shirika la ndege la humu nchini lililoteuliwa na Serikali kuwa shirika la taifa, kwa mtu asiye mkazi, kwa ajili ya kufikia au kutumia mfumo wa kidijitali au wa malipo (kama mtandao wa malipo au mpango wa kadi), bila kujali ada hiyo inaitwaje. Katika kifungu kidogo cha (3), uuzaji wa vyuma chakavu na ushindi pia vinaongezwa kwenye orodha, kama aya (p) na (q).
explanation.sheng: Section 35 ya Income Tax Act ina list ya payments zenye tax deducted at source, na section hii ina-change list hiyo. Kwa subsection (1), word "travel" inakuwa "transport services" kwa one paragraph, paragraph (u) ina-delete-iwa, na sale ya scrap metal na winnings zina-add-iwa kama paragraphs (v) na (w). Pia kuna new subsection (1A): subsection (1) haiapply kwa payments za airline ya Kenya ambayo Government ime-designate kama national carrier, kama inalipa non-resident kwa access au use ya digital platform au payment system (kama card scheme au payment network), hata fee iitwe nini. Kwa subsection (3), sale ya scrap metal na winnings pia zina-add-iwa kwa list, kama paragraphs (p) na (q).

neutral_check.note: Describes the list changes and the new exception only, with no opinion, advice or verdict. Tax rates are not in the text, so none are stated.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 52 of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 17.Section 52 of the Income Tax Act is amended in subsection (1), by deleting the words "within a reasonable time, not being less than thirty days from the date of service of the notice" appearing immediately after the words "furnish him" and substituting therefor the words "by the last day of the fourth month following the end of the person's year of income".

explanation.en: Section 17 changes section 52(1) of the Income Tax Act. Before, a person had to give what the notice asked for within a reasonable time, which could not be less than thirty days from the date the notice was served. Now the deadline is the last day of the fourth month after the end of that person's year of income.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 17 kinarekebisha kifungu cha 52(1) cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Awali, muda wa kutoa kile ambacho notisi inahitaji ulikuwa "muda unaofaa", usiopungua siku thelathini tangu notisi ilipotolewa. Sasa muda huo ni siku ya mwisho ya mwezi wa nne baada ya mwaka wa mapato wa mtu huyo kuisha.
explanation.sheng: Section 17 ina-change section 52(1) ya Income Tax Act. Deadline ya ku-send information ambayo notice ina-ask ilikuwa reasonable time, si chini ya thirty days from the date notice ina-delivered. Sasa deadline ni last day ya fourth month baada ya year of income ya person kuisha.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the change of deadline in the text, with no opinion, advice or legal judgment. It applies to any person, so no group is tagged.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 52B of Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 18.Section 52B of the Income Tax Act is amended by deleting in subsection (1) and substituting therefor the following new subsection- (1)Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act - (a) every individual chargeable to tax under this Act shall for any year of income, furnish to the Commissioner a return of income, including a selfassessment of their tax from all sources of income, not later than the last day of the fourth month following the end of their year of income; and (b) every person, other than an individual chargeable to tax under paragraph (a), shall for any accounting period furnish to the Commissioner a return of income, including a self-assessment of his tax on such income, not later than the last day of the sixth month following the end of his accounting period.

explanation.en: Section 18 replaces subsection (1) of section 52B of the Income Tax Act, which sets the deadlines for filing tax returns. Every individual who is chargeable to tax must give the Commissioner a return of income for the year of income, including their own calculation of tax (self-assessment) on income from all sources. The deadline is the last day of the fourth month after the year of income ends. Every other person chargeable to tax, such as a company, must file a return with a self-assessment for the accounting period by the last day of the sixth month after that period ends.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 18 kinabadilisha kifungu kidogo cha (1) cha kifungu cha 52B cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, kinachoweka tarehe za kuwasilisha ritani za kodi. Kila mtu binafsi anayetozwa kodi anatakiwa kumwasilishia Kamishna ritani ya mapato ya mwaka wa mapato, pamoja na ukadiriaji wake mwenyewe wa kodi kutoka vyanzo vyote vya mapato. Tarehe ya mwisho ni siku ya mwisho ya mwezi wa nne baada ya mwaka wa mapato kuisha. Kila mtu mwingine anayetozwa kodi, kama kampuni, anatakiwa kuwasilisha ritani na ukadiriaji wa kodi wa kipindi cha uhasibu kufikia siku ya mwisho ya mwezi wa sita baada ya kipindi hicho kuisha.
explanation.sheng: Section 18 ina-replace subsection (1) ya section 52B ya Income Tax Act, ambayo ina-set deadline za kufile returns. Every individual anayetozwa tax ana-file return of income kwa Commissioner pamoja na self-assessment (ana-calculate tax yake mwenyewe) from all sources za income, kufikia last day ya fourth month after year of income iishe. Every other person anayetozwa tax, kama company, ana-file return na self-assessment kwa accounting period kufikia last day ya sixth month after accounting period iishe.

neutral_check.note: Section sets filing deadlines for all taxpayers; described only what it does, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Amendment of the First Schedule to Cap.470.
clauses.text: 19.Part I of the First Schedule to the Income Tax is amended- (a) in paragraph 53, by inserting the following paragraph immediately after paragraph (c) of the proviso- (d ) benefits arising due to death; (b) inserting the following new paragraph immediately after paragraph 75- 76. Any capital gains relating to the transfer of property to a real estate investment trust registered by the Commissioner under section 20 (1).

explanation.en: This section changes the list of income that is exempt from tax in Part I of the First Schedule to the Income Tax Act. First, it adds a new item (d), "benefits arising due to death", to the conditions attached to paragraph 53. Second, it adds a new paragraph 76 to the list: any capital gains from transferring property to a real estate investment trust registered by the Commissioner under section 20(1).
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha orodha ya mapato yasiyotozwa kodi katika Sehemu ya I ya Jedwali la Kwanza la Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Kwanza, kinaongeza kipengele kipya (d), "manufaa yanayotokana na kifo", kwenye masharti yaliyoambatanishwa na aya ya 53. Pili, kinaongeza aya mpya ya 76 kwenye orodha hiyo: faida yoyote ya mtaji inayotokana na kuhamisha mali kwa mfuko wa uwekezaji katika mali isiyohamishika uliosajiliwa na Kamishna chini ya kifungu cha 20(1).
explanation.sheng: Section hii ina-amend list ya income isiyo na tax kwenye Part I ya First Schedule ya Income Tax Act. Kwanza, ina-add item mpya (d), benefits zinazolipwa kwa sababu ya death, kwa conditions za paragraph 53. Pili, ina-add paragraph mpya 76 kwa list hiyo: capital gains zozote kutoka transfer ya property kwa real estate investment trust iliyo-registeriwa na Commissioner under section 20(1).

neutral_check.note: Describes the two list changes in plain words without opinion, advice or any view on legality.

clauses.heading: Amendment of the Second Schedule to Cap.470.
clauses.text: 20.The Second Schedule to the Income Tax Act is amended in the table appearing in paragraph 1 (1 ) - (a) in item (iv) in the second column by inserting the following proviso- Provided that where the investment is in excess of ten billion shillings 100% in the first year of use. (b) by inserting the words " per year, in equal instalments" immediately after the expression "10%" appearing in item (a) (viii).

explanation.en: This section changes the table in paragraph 1(1) of the Second Schedule to the Income Tax Act in two ways. First, in item (iv), it adds a condition to the rate: where the investment is more than ten billion shillings, the rate is 100% in the first year of use. Second, in item (a)(viii), it adds the words "per year, in equal instalments" after the 10% rate, so the 10% applies each year in equal parts.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha jedwali lililo katika aya ya 1(1) ya Jedwali la Pili la Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, katika kipengee cha (iv), kinaongeza sharti kwamba pale uwekezaji unapozidi shilingi bilioni kumi, kiwango ni asilimia 100 katika mwaka wa kwanza wa matumizi. Pili, katika kipengee cha (a)(viii), kinaongeza maneno "kwa mwaka, kwa awamu sawa" baada ya asilimia 10, kwa hiyo asilimia 10 inatumika kila mwaka kwa sehemu sawa.
explanation.sheng: Section hii ina-amend table ya rates kwenye paragraph 1(1) ya Second Schedule ya Income Tax Act, kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, kwa item (iv), ina-add condition kwa rate: kama investment ni above ten billion shillings, rate ni 100% kwa first year ya use. Pili, kwa item (a)(viii), ina-add words "per year, in equal instalments" baada ya 10%, kwa hivyo 10% ina-apply every year in equal parts.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the two textual changes to the table and the conditions in them, with no judgement on the policy.

clauses.heading: Amendment of the Third Schedule to Cap.470.
clauses.text: 21. Head B of the Third Schedule to the Income Tax Act is amended- (a) in paragraph 2, by deleting subparagraph (i); (b) in paragraph 3- (i) by deleting the proviso to subparagraph (d); (ii)by inserting the following new subparagraphs immediately after subparagraph (w)- (x) in respect of the sale of scrap metal, one and a half per cent of the gross amount; (y) in respect of winnings, twenty per cent; (c) in paragraph 5, inserting the following new subparagraphs immediately after subparagraph (p)- (q) in respect of the sale of scrap metal, one and a half per cent of the gross amount; (r) in respect of winnings, twenty per cent.

explanation.en: Section 21 amends Head B of the Third Schedule to the Income Tax Act. It deletes subparagraph (i) of paragraph 2, and deletes the condition (proviso) attached to subparagraph (d) of paragraph 3. In both paragraph 3 and paragraph 5 it adds two new rates: 1.5% of the gross amount (the total before anything is taken off) for the sale of scrap metal, and 20% for winnings.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 21 kinarekebisha Sehemu B ya Jedwali la Tatu la Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. Kinafuta kifungu kidogo (i) cha aya ya 2, na kufuta sharti lililoambatana na kifungu kidogo (d) cha aya ya 3. Katika aya ya 3 na aya ya 5, kinaongeza viwango viwili vipya: asilimia 1.5 ya jumla ya kiasi kizima (kabla ya makato yoyote) kwa mauzo ya vyuma chakavu, na asilimia 20 kwa zawadi za ushindi.
explanation.sheng: Section 21 ina-amend Head B ya Third Schedule ya Income Tax Act. Ina-delete subparagraph (i) ya paragraph 2, na pia ina-delete condition (proviso) iliyokuwa kwa subparagraph (d) ya paragraph 3. Kwa paragraph 3 na paragraph 5, ina-add two new rates: 1.5% ya gross amount (total before kitu yoyote kukatwa) kwa sale ya scrap metal, na 20% kwa winnings.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the deletions and the two new rates stated in the text, with no opinion on them and no claims about what the deleted provisions contained.

clauses.heading: Amendment of the Fourth Schedule to Cap.470.
clauses.text: 22.The Fourth Schedule to the Income Tax Act is amended by inserting the following new item- A financial institution licenced under the Microfinance Act (Cap. 493C .)

explanation.en: Section 22 amends the Fourth Schedule to the Income Tax Act by adding one new item to its list: a financial institution licensed under the Microfinance Act (Cap. 493C). That is the only change this section makes. What being on that list means is set out in the Income Tax Act itself, not in this clause.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 22 kinarekebisha Jedwali la Nne la Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato (Income Tax Act) kwa kuongeza kipengee kimoja kipya kwenye orodha yake: taasisi ya kifedha iliyopewa leseni chini ya Sheria ya Microfinance (Cap. 493C). Hiyo ndiyo mabadiliko pekee katika kifungu hiki. Maana ya kuwa kwenye orodha hiyo imo katika Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato yenyewe, si katika kifungu hiki.
explanation.sheng: Section 22 ina-amend Fourth Schedule ya Income Tax Act kwa ku-add new item kwa list: financial institution yenye licence under Microfinance Act (Cap. 493C). Hiyo ndiyo change pekee kwenye section hii. Meaning ya kuwa kwenye list hiyo iko kwa Income Tax Act yenyewe, si kwa clause hii.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the single added item in the schedule; no opinion, advice or judgement on legality, and no claim about the schedule's purpose beyond the text.

clauses.heading: Amendment of the Eighth Schedule to Cap.470.
clauses.text: 23.The Eighth Schedule to the Income Tax Act is amended- (a) in paragraph 2- (i) in subparagraph (c), by deleting the expression "subparagraph (a)" appearing immediately after the words "to which" and substituting therefor the expression "subparagraph (b )"; (ii) by inserting the following new subparagraph immediately after subparagraph (c)- (d) gains derived from the alienation of shares by a non-resident person where the shares derive their value from Kenya or the alienation results in a change of the group membership of a company resident in Kenya or of ownership of, title in, or interest in property located in Kenya. (b) in paragraph 8 (4 A) by inserting the words ", other than a transfer to which paragraph 6(2)(i) applies," immediately after the words "Capital Gains Tax".

explanation.en: Section 23 makes three changes to the Eighth Schedule of the Income Tax Act. In paragraph 2(c), it corrects a cross-reference so it points to subparagraph (b) instead of subparagraph (a). It also adds a new item (d) to paragraph 2: gains from the sale or transfer of shares by a non-resident, where the shares get their value from Kenya, or the transfer changes the group membership of a company resident in Kenya, or changes ownership of or interest in property in Kenya. In paragraph 8(4A), it adds words after "Capital Gains Tax" so that a transfer covered by paragraph 6(2)(i) is left out of that subparagraph.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 23 kinafanya mabadiliko matatu kwenye Jedwali la Nane la Sheria ya Ushuru wa Mapato. Katika aya ya 2(c), kinarekebisha rejeleo ili lielekeze kwenye kifungu kidogo (b) badala ya (a). Pia kinaongeza kipengele kipya (d) kwenye aya ya 2: faida kutokana na uuzaji au uhamisho wa hisa unaofanywa na mtu asiye mkazi, pale hisa hizo zinapopata thamani yake kutoka Kenya, au uhamisho huo unapobadilisha uanachama wa kikundi wa kampuni inayokaa Kenya, au umiliki wa mali au haki katika mali iliyoko Kenya. Katika aya ya 8(4A), kinaongeza maneno baada ya "Capital Gains Tax" ili uhamisho unaohusika na aya ya 6(2)(i) usijumuishwe katika kifungu hicho kidogo.
explanation.sheng: Section 23 inarekebisha Eighth Schedule ya Income Tax Act kwa changes tatu. Kwa paragraph 2(c), ina-correct reference: badala ya subparagraph (a), sasa inaenda kwa subparagraph (b). Pia ina-add item (d) kwa paragraph 2: gains kutoka sale au transfer ya shares na non-resident, kama shares zinapata value yao kutoka Kenya, au transfer ina-change group membership ya company iliyo Kenya, au ownership ya property iliyo Kenya. Kwa paragraph 8(4A), ina-add maneno baada ya Capital Gains Tax ili transfer inayofunikwa na paragraph 6(2)(i) isiwe included kwa hiyo subparagraph.

neutral_check.note: Describes only what the amendments change (a cross-reference fix, a new item on non-resident share gains, and an exclusion in paragraph 8(4A)), with no opinion, advice or legal judgment.

clauses.heading: Amendment of the Ninth Schedule to Cap. 470.
clauses.text: 24.The Ninth Schedule to the Income Tax Act is amended- (a) in paragraph 2, by inserting the following new subparagraph immediately after subparagraph (3)- (4) The non-resident tax rates for repatriated income by a licensee under section 7B shall be fifteen per cent. (b) in paragraph 7 - (i) in subparagraph (3), by deleting the words "thirty-seven and a half percent" appearing in item (b) immediately after the words "nonresident company" and substituting therefor the words "thirty percent"; (ii) by inserting the following new paragraph immediately after paragraph (3)- (4) The non-resident tax rates for repatriated income by a contractor under section 7B shall be fifteen per cent. PART Ill-VALUE ADDED TAX

explanation.en: This section changes the Ninth Schedule of the Income Tax Act, which lists tax rates. It sets a 15% tax rate for non-residents on repatriated income (income sent out of Kenya) of a licensee under section 7B, and the same 15% rate for a contractor under section 7B. It also lowers the rate for a non-resident company in paragraph 7(3)(b) from 37.5% to 30%.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha Jedwali la Tisa la Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, linaloorodhesha viwango vya kodi. Kinaweka kiwango cha kodi cha asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi kwa mapato yanayopelekwa nje ya Kenya na mwenye leseni chini ya kifungu cha 7B, na kiwango hicho hicho kwa mkandarasi chini ya kifungu cha 7B. Pia kinapunguza kiwango cha kampuni ya mtu asiye mkazi katika aya ya 7(3)(b) kutoka asilimia 37.5 hadi asilimia 30.
explanation.sheng: Section hii ina-amend Ninth Schedule ya Income Tax Act, ambayo ina list ya tax rates. Ina-set tax rate ya 15% kwa non-residents kwa repatriated income (income inayotumwa nje ya Kenya) ya licensee under section 7B, na 15% pia kwa contractor under section 7B. Pia ina-reduce tax rate ya non-resident company kwa paragraph 7(3)(b) kutoka 37.5% hadi 30%.

neutral_check.note: Describes the rate changes for licensees, contractors and non-resident companies only, with no opinion, advice or legal judgment. The trailing 'PART III-VALUE ADDED TAX' is a heading, not part of this section, so it is not explained.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 2 of Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 25.Section 2 of the Value Added Tax Act is amended in subsection ( 1 )- (a) by deleting the definition of "assessment"; (b) by deleting the definition of "information technology"; ( c) by deleting the definition of "tax computerized system".

explanation.en: This section changes the list of definitions at the start of the Value Added Tax (VAT) Act, in section 2(1). It deletes three definitions: "assessment", "information technology" and "tax computerized system". It is a small technical amendment to a definitions clause, and the section itself adds nothing new.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha orodha ya ufafanuzi wa maneno mwanzoni mwa Sheria ya Ushuru wa Ongezeko la Thamani (VAT), katika kifungu cha 2(1). Kinafuta ufafanuzi wa maneno matatu: "assessment" (tathmini ya kodi), "information technology" (teknolojia ya habari) na "tax computerized system" (mfumo wa kodi wa kompyuta). Ni marekebisho madogo ya kiufundi ya ufafanuzi tu, na kifungu chenyewe hakiongezi kitu kipya.
explanation.sheng: Section 25 ina-amend section 2(1) ya Value Added Tax Act (VAT Act), ile part ya definitions. Ina-delete three definitions: "assessment", "information technology" na "tax computerized system". Ni small technical change ya definitions tu, na section yenyewe haija-add kitu kipya.

neutral_check.note: Technical deletion of three definitions, described plainly with no opinion, advice or legal judgement.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 13 of Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 26.Section 13 of the Value Added Tax Act is amended- (a) by inserting the following new subsections immediately after subsection (5) - (5A) Subject to subsection 5, where a supplier provides labour, outsourcing or employee placement services and incurs employee-related costs, such costs shall be deemed to be disbursements made by the supplier on behalf of the client. (5B) For the purpose of subsection (5A), "employee related costs" includes salaries, wages, statutory deductions and such other related costs. (b) in subsection (6), by deleting paragraph (a) and substituting therefor the following new paragraph- (a) in the case of a supply of goods from a person licenced to carry on hire purchase business under a hire purchase agreement registered in accordance with the Hire Purchase Act, any financial charge payable in relation to the supply of credit under the agreement.

explanation.en: Section 26 changes section 13 of the VAT Act in two ways. First, it adds two new subsections: when a supplier of labour, outsourcing or employee placement services pays employee-related costs (salaries, wages, statutory deductions and similar costs), those costs are treated as disbursements, meaning money paid on behalf of the client. Second, it replaces paragraph (a) of subsection (6) with new wording: for goods supplied by a licensed hire purchase business under a hire purchase agreement registered under the Hire Purchase Act, the paragraph covers any financial charge payable for the credit under that agreement.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha kifungu cha 13 cha Sheria ya VAT kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, kinaongeza vifungu vidogo viwili vipya: mtoaji wa huduma za wafanyakazi, utoaji wa kazi nje (outsourcing) au uwekaji wa wafanyakazi akilipa gharama za wafanyakazi (mishahara, ujira, makato ya kisheria na gharama zinazofanana), gharama hizo huchukuliwa kama malipo yaliyofanywa kwa niaba ya mteja. Pili, kinabadilisha aya (a) ya kifungu kidogo cha (6) ili, kwa bidhaa zinazotolewa na mwenye leseni ya biashara ya hire purchase chini ya mkataba uliosajiliwa kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Hire Purchase, aya hiyo itaje ada yoyote ya kifedha inayolipwa kwa mkopo chini ya mkataba huo.
explanation.sheng: Section 26 ina-amend section 13 ya VAT Act kwa njia mbili. Kwanza, ina-add subsections mbili mpya: kama supplier wa labour, outsourcing au employee placement services ana-pay employee costs kama salaries, wages na statutory deductions, costs hizo zina-count kama disbursements, yaani pesa alizolipa on behalf of the client. Pili, ina-replace paragraph (a) ya subsection (6): kwa goods zinazotoka kwa business yenye hire purchase licence chini ya agreement iliyo-registered kwa Hire Purchase Act, paragraph hiyo inataja financial charge yoyote ya credit chini ya agreement hiyo.

neutral_check.note: Describes only what the two amendments do, with no opinion on their effect. Not tagged to a group because the text applies to labour suppliers and licensed hire purchase businesses generally, not to a named group.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 17 of Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 27.Section 17 of the Value Added Tax Act is amended - (a) in subsection 5, by inserting the following new paragraph immediately after paragraph (d)- (e) input tax is attributable to supplies made to the Kenya Defence Forces, the Defence Forces Welfare Services, the National Intelligence Service and the National Police Service, where such supplies are specified as exempt under paragraphs 57 and 101 of the First Schedule. (b) by inserting the following new sub-sections immediately after subsection (6) - (7) Notwithstanding subsection (6), a registered person shall be entitled to deduct input tax incurred in respect of supplies made to the Kenya Defence Forces, Defence Forces Welfare Services, the National Intelligence Service and the National Police Service: Provided that- ( a) the supplies are supported by such documentation as the Commissioner may prescribe; and (b) the deductions are limited to input tax directly attributable to those supplies. (8) For the avoidance of doubt, input tax deducted under subsection (7) shall not be subject to apportionment under subsection (5) where it is wholly attributable to the supplies specified therein.

explanation.en: This section changes section 17 of the VAT Act, which deals with input tax (the VAT a business pays on what it buys). It adds a new item (e) to the list in subsection 5 covering input tax linked to supplies to the Kenya Defence Forces, the Defence Forces Welfare Services, the National Intelligence Service and the National Police Service, where those supplies are listed as exempt in paragraphs 57 and 101 of the First Schedule. It also adds subsections 7 and 8: a registered person can deduct input tax on supplies to those four bodies, as long as the supplies have the documents the Commissioner prescribes and the deduction covers only input tax directly attributable to them. Input tax deducted this way is not apportioned under subsection 5 when it is wholly attributable to those supplies.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha kifungu cha 17 cha Sheria ya Ushuru wa Ongezeko la Thamani (VAT), kinachohusu kodi ya pembejeo (VAT anayolipa mfanyabiashara kwa bidhaa na huduma anazonunua). Kinaongeza aya mpya (e) kwenye orodha ya kifungu kidogo cha (5) kuhusu kodi ya pembejeo inayohusiana na bidhaa na huduma zinazotolewa kwa Jeshi la Ulinzi la Kenya, Huduma za Ustawi wa Vikosi vya Ulinzi, Huduma ya Kitaifa ya Ujasusi na Huduma ya Taifa ya Polisi, ambapo zimeorodheshwa kama zisizotozwa VAT katika aya ya 57 na 101 za Jedwali la Kwanza. Pia kinaongeza vifungu vidogo vya (7) na (8): mtu aliyesajiliwa anaweza kukata kodi ya pembejeo kwa bidhaa na huduma zinazotolewa kwa taasisi hizo nne, mradi kuna nyaraka atakazobainisha Kamishna na makato yanahusu kodi ya pembejeo inayohusiana moja kwa moja nazo. Kodi ya pembejeo iliyokatwa kwa njia hii haigawanywi chini ya kifungu kidogo cha (5) ikiwa inahusiana kikamilifu na bidhaa na huduma hizo.
explanation.sheng: Section 27 ina-amend section 17 ya VAT Act, inayohusu input tax (VAT anayolipa business kwa vitu ana-buy). Ina-add item new (e) kwa list ya subsection 5 kuhusu input tax ya supplies kwa Kenya Defence Forces, Defence Forces Welfare Services, National Intelligence Service na National Police Service, kama supplies hizo zime-listed kama exempt kwa paragraphs 57 na 101 za First Schedule. Pia ina-add subsections 7 na 8: registered person anaweza ku-deduct input tax ya supplies kwa hizo four bodies, kama kuna documents ambazo Commissioner ana-prescribe na deduction ni ya input tax inayo-relate directly na supplies hizo. Input tax iliyo-deductiwa hivyo haiwezi ku-apportionwa chini ya subsection 5 kama ni wholly ya supplies hizo.

neutral_check.note: Described only what the amendments add and the conditions attached, with no opinion, advice or judgement on legality.

clauses.heading: Insertion of a new section 17A to Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 28.The Value Added Tax Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 17 - Adjustment of input 17A . (1) Where, on the date taxable tax after supplies become exempt. supplies by a registered person become exempt and the person has deducted input tax on such supplies but the supplies remain unsold, the person shall account for an amount equal to the input tax relating to the supplies which remain unsold in the tax return of the period when the taxable supply became exempt. (2) When accounting for input tax under subsection (1), the person shall use the method used when input tax was deducted in respect of the supplies before the date the supplies became exempt. (3) Where the adjustment results in excess input tax, the person shall be liable to pay the resulting tax to the Commissioner.

explanation.en: Section 28 adds a new section 17A to the VAT Act. It covers a VAT-registered person whose taxable supplies (goods or services) become exempt from VAT after the person has already deducted input tax (the VAT paid on buying them) on supplies that are still unsold. For that unsold stock, the person adds an amount equal to the input tax to the tax return for the period when the supplies became exempt, using the same method used when the input tax was first deducted. If the adjustment leaves excess input tax, the person owes that tax to the Commissioner.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 28 kinaongeza kifungu kipya cha 17A katika Sheria ya VAT. Kinahusu mtu aliyesajiliwa kwa VAT ambaye bidhaa au huduma zake zinazotozwa VAT zinakuwa zisizotozwa ushuru (exempt), baada ya kuwa amekata ushuru wa pembejeo (input tax, yaani VAT aliyolipa wakati wa kununua) kwa bidhaa ambazo bado hazijauzwa. Kwa bidhaa hizo, anaongeza kiasi sawa na ushuru huo wa pembejeo kwenye marejesho ya kodi ya kipindi ambacho zilikuwa exempt, akitumia njia ile ile aliyotumia kukata ushuru huo mwanzoni. Marekebisho yakisababisha ushuru wa pembejeo wa ziada, mtu huyo anawajibika kulipa ushuru huo kwa Kamishna.
explanation.sheng: Section 28 ina-insert section 17A mpya kwa VAT Act. Inahusu registered person ambaye supplies zake zina-become exempt kutoka VAT, na tayari ame-deduct input tax (VAT aliyolipa ku-buy hizo supplies) kwa supplies ambazo bado ni unsold. Kwa hizo unsold supplies, ana-add amount sawa na input tax kwa tax return ya period ambayo supplies zilikuwa exempt, akitumia method ile ile aliyotumia ku-deduct input tax mwanzoni. Kama adjustment inaleta excess input tax, ana-pay hiyo tax kwa Commissioner.

neutral_check.note: Describes the new VAT adjustment rule and who it applies to, with no opinion, advice or legal judgement.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 31 of Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 29.Section 31 of the Value Added Tax Act is amended in subsection (1), by deleting the words "two years" appearing in paragraph (a) immediately after the words "period of' and substituting therefor the words "three years".

explanation.en: This section amends section 31 of the Value Added Tax Act. In subsection (1), paragraph (a), the period of "two years" is replaced with "three years". It is a small technical change that lengthens that one period by a year and changes nothing else in the section.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinarekebisha kifungu cha 31 cha Sheria ya Ushuru wa Thamani Iliyoongezwa (VAT). Katika kifungu kidogo cha (1), aya (a), muda wa "miaka miwili" unabadilishwa kuwa "miaka mitatu". Ni marekebisho madogo ya kiufundi yanayoongeza muda huo kwa mwaka mmoja tu, na hakuna kingine kinachobadilika katika kifungu hicho.
explanation.sheng: Section 29 ina-amend section 31 ya VAT Act. Kwa subsection (1), paragraph (a), period ya "two years" ina-replaciwa na "three years". Ni technical change ndogo tu: period moja inaongezwa na one year, na kitu kingine hakibadiliki kwa hiyo section.

neutral_check.note: The clause only swaps one number, and the explanation describes that change without opinion, advice or any comment on legality.

clauses.heading: Amendment of section 42 of Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 30.Section 42 of the Value Added Tax Act is amended by deleting subsection (2) and substituting therefor the following new subsection- (2) An invoice showing an amount that purports to be tax shall only be issued in respect of a taxable supply.

explanation.en: This section removes subsection (2) of section 42 of the Value Added Tax (VAT) Act and puts a new subsection (2) in its place. The new subsection says an invoice that shows an amount claimed to be tax can only be issued for a taxable supply. A taxable supply is a sale of goods or services that VAT applies to.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinafuta kifungu kidogo cha (2) cha kifungu cha 42 cha Sheria ya Ushuru wa Ongezeko la Thamani (VAT) na kuweka kifungu kidogo kipya cha (2). Kifungu kipya kinasema ankara inayoonyesha kiasi kinachodaiwa kuwa ushuru inaweza kutolewa tu kwa bidhaa au huduma zinazotozwa VAT (taxable supply).
explanation.sheng: Section 30 ina-delete subsection (2) ya section 42 ya VAT Act na ina-put subsection (2) mpya. Subsection mpya inasema invoice ina-show amount inayosemekana ni tax inaweza ku-be issued tu kwa taxable supply, yaani sale ya goods au services ambazo VAT ina-apply.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the replacement of one subsection and what the new wording says, with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Repeal of section 66 of Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 31. The Value Added Tax Act is amended by repealing section 66.

explanation.en: This section removes section 66 from the Value Added Tax Act completely. The clause does not say what section 66 covered, so the effect depends on what that section provided. After the repeal, section 66 no longer forms part of the Act.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaondoa kabisa kifungu cha 66 kutoka kwa Sheria ya Ushuru wa Thamani ya Ziada (VAT). Kifungu hiki hakisemi kifungu cha 66 kilihusu nini, kwa hivyo athari inategemea kilichokuwa kimeandikwa humo. Baada ya kufutwa, kifungu cha 66 hakitakuwa tena sehemu ya Sheria hiyo.
explanation.sheng: Section hii in-repeal section 66 ya VAT Act, yaani inaondolewa kabisa kwa Act. Clause haisemi section 66 ilikuwa inahusu nini, kwa hivyo effect inategemea ilichokuwa imeandikwa huko. Baada ya repeal, section 66 haitakuwa tena part ya Act.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the repeal of a section, without opinion, advice or any comment on its validity. No group is tagged because the clause does not show who is affected.

clauses.heading: Amendment of First Schedule to Cap. 476.
clauses.text: 32.Section A of the First Schedule to the Value Added Tax Act is amended- (a) in Part 1- (i) by deleting paragraph 49; (ii) in paragraph 51- (A) by inserting the words "spare parts" immediately after the word "lubricants" appearing in paragraph 51; (B) by inserting the following new proviso- Provided that any exemption granted for spare parts before the 30th June, 2026, shall apply until the conclusion of the project. (iii) by deleting paragraph 58; (iv) by deleting paragraph 62; (v) by deleting the words "any other aircraft spare" appearing in paragraph 89 and substituting therefor the word "aircraft"; (vi) by deleting the words "three hundred" appearing in paragraph 99 (i) and substituting therefore the words "two thousand"; (vii) by deleting paragraph 109; (viii) by deleting paragraph 146 and substituting therefor the following new paragraph- 146.
